subject: Nimble is looking for a one-year post-doc on spatial capture-recapture

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Nimble is looking for a one-year post-doc on spatial capture-recapture
parts:
Hi everyone,

The Nimble team at UC Berkeley will be looking to hire a post-doctoral researcher for a one-year position to work on ecological spatial capture-recapture models in tandem with nimble development work in R. The project will involve integration of telemetry data and SCR data from the California Department of Fish & Wildlife as well as software development within nimble tailored to the specific models of interest. The position can begin as early as July 1, 2024. We do not yet have a formal job advertisement but wanted to spread the word as soon as possible. Please reply directly to us (Perry and Chris, but not the entire nimble-users list!) with a short note and CV if you would like to learn more. Please forward to others who might be interested.

Perry, Chris, and the Nimble team

P.S. We are not yet sure whether this role will support a US visa for a non-US citizen to take the job, so please reach out to us either way.
